text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wham! Thud! BAM!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I
suddenly hear
a violent cacophony.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Haha! Ahahaha! AAAHAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Behold the eidos of my psyche! Hearken
to the
sheer lament of my flesh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet roars with laughter before
a pile of
cardboard boxes... all of which
are squashed and
flattened!
Whoa! That is awesome!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Did you do all this yourself? These boxes are mega flat!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I merely obeyed my ethos, and
this is the
result.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...So, did you find the you-know-what?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sure did! I went and got us this plastic
twine! Let's
get this stuff bundled up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pair set about swiftly binding the
flattened
cardboard together with the
plastic twine. They
must be getting it
ready for recycling.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What is it? What are you looking at? Do
you
yearn for destruction as well?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
But of course. Destruction and rebirth
are but two
sides of the selfsame coin.
choice_data_list: いや……自分で片付けるんだなと思って
choice_data_list_en: No... I was just thinking how great it is that you clean up after yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
So, is it rebirth you seek? Or do you wish
to
plunge into the euphoria of
destruction?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must be asking whether I'd rather
help bundle
up the cardboard or flatten
more boxes.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. Then go forth and use the
threads of
logos to pinion this chaos.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I think she means, "Go ahead and
use the
twine to tie the flattened boxes
together!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of us bundle up the cardboard
before
tidying the stacks away, leaving
the once chaotic
scene spotless.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The chaos has met its demise,
and order
has been restored to Gaia.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still have no idea what cryptic
meanings lie
behind Tanino Gimlet's
remarks, but I feel much
better now that
all the clutter is gone.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. Thankfully, sacrifices remain
to be
made.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, me too! Let me help too! Okay, let's
make a
contest outta this!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Release your mortal flesh from its
shackles!
Relinquish all and surrender
yourself to the chaos!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: RAAAAARGH!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I can see the depths of your
potential now!
The day of your
liberation from the realm of ideas
must
be close at hand.
choice_data_list: ウオオオオオーーーーッ！！！！
